question: In Sentinel-2 and Pléiades Neo bands, what reflectance contrast does kelp (order Laminariales) have against the substrates it replaces (sand, rock, turf, red foliose algae, coralline crust) and against other brown algae; how far below the surface does each contrast survive at Sesimbra's water clarity; and which normalised difference should the E4t-B flat test use?
kind: Characterisation. There is no pass or fail; the decision rules below are fixed before any contrast is computed.

rowan_phinn.citation: Rowan, Gillian, Phinn, Stuart, Smart, Joanna N. and Roelfsema, Chris (2025). Hyperspectral Reflectance Measurements of Kelps, Macroalgae, and Co-ocurring Materials Collected in Australia and New Zealand. The University of Queensland. (Dataset) doi: 10.48610/c5f745e
rowan_phinn.licence: Permitted re-use with acknowledgement; not redistributed; the full citation goes in every output that relies on it
rowan_phinn.file: .cache/spectra/rowan_phinn/spectra.csv (sha1 e39f8c71dc9baa2324e0a2d4c4b26f47d2977f3f, as in the dataset's bag manifest)
rowan_phinn.geometry: air (in situ, natural light, spectra affected by overlying water removed by the authors)

vahtmae.taxon_field: first word of 'Scientific name (Target in Latin)', else 'Description (Target description)'

fuller.record: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10826300, CC-BY-4.0 (Fuller, Martin, Asner 2024, Remote Sensing 16:1140)
fuller.reader: spectra.read_asd_library, metadata from the species table joined on 'Spectral ID'
fuller.geometry: 'ex-situ' rows: air. 'in-situ' rows: in situ, measurement geometry not stated in the data record (the paper was not reachable); treated as its own geometry

glovers.geometry: underwater contact (probe about 5 cm from the target, artificial light, 5-6 m)

vigo.geometry: underwater imaging (estimated reflectance); lab sediments scanned in water

wallis.file: .cache/spectra/wallis/*/*/*_rawdata.txt with *_metadata.txt, except the WallisLake_200805_representative files, a subset of WallisLake_200805
wallis.reader: spectra.read_columns_csv(delimiter tab, encoding latin-1), metadata joined on the spectrum name after 'xls_'
wallis.geometry: air; the 'submerged ...' targets through 5-10 cm of water

brown_other.note: Fuller's Chrysocystis is listed as brown but is not a brown alga (Phaeophyceae) and is excluded. Durvillaea is called bull kelp but belongs to Fucales.

sediment.note: Reported for a Ria Formosa retest; not part of the kelp contrasts.

sediment_film.note: Two spectra: reported, below the minimum for scoring.

bands.sentinel2: ESA COPE-GSEG-EOPG-TN-15-0007 v4.0, Sentinel-2A, from ACOLITE 64a02ff data/RSR/S2A_MSI_V4.txt: B1, B2, B3, B4, B5
bands.pleiades_neo: Airbus, PNEO3 (the Sesimbra 8 July 2026 platform), from ACOLITE 64a02ff data/RSR/PNEO3.txt: B1 (coastal blue), B2, B3, B4, B5 (red edge); in air only
bands.native_10m: B2, B3, B4 (Sentinel-2); B1 is 60 m and B5 20 m

statistics.support: A class is scored only with at least 5 spectra; otherwise its band values are reported and it is not scored.
statistics.taxon_balance: Every taxon (source and taxon field) in a class carries equal weight: class medians and quartiles are weighted so each taxon sums to one, and Monte Carlo draws pick a taxon uniformly, then a spectrum within it. Durvillaea (119 of 388 Rowan & Phinn spectra) does not dominate its class.
statistics.separability: Mann-Whitney AUC between kelp and each class, per band and per normalised difference ND(i,j) = (R_i - R_j) / (R_i + R_j) of two bands; each index is oriented so that kelp has the higher median in air.
statistics.contrast: Delta rho_b = |taxon-balanced median(kelp) - median(class)| per band.

water.model: Lee forward model and the library correction (inversion.lee.invert_scene) with known IOPs and depth, as in coastal_validation/e5b2_index.py; noise added to above-water Rrs as sigma / pi.

iops.source: Forced-560 QAA at Sesimbra, E2c (reports/e2c-sesimbra/<date>/forced_560/iops.json): 2025-12-24 and 2026-02-22, at 442, 492, 559, 665 and 704 nm for Sentinel-2 B1-B5.
iops.primary: per-band median of the two dates

water.sigma_basis: Sesimbra's measured AC scatter over bottom-blind water is 0.0006-0.0037 (median, 100 m blocks) and 0.005-0.009 (90th percentile) in kelp_observe/outputs/diagnostics/ac_uncertainty.json; the grid is E5b-2's.
water.z_max: detectability.z_max_from_k(k, sigma, Delta rho_b, t_aw = 0.52), with k the two-way bottom attenuation of the same forward model, (1/cos(theta_w) + Du_bottom) (a + bb), for each IOP set.

analyses.sensitivity_air_only: Only spectra measured in air (Rowan & Phinn, Vahtmäe, Fuller ex-situ, Wallis above water).
analyses.geometry: Fuller genera with both ex-situ and in-situ spectra (Acanthophora, Dichotomaria, Dictyosphaeria, Eucheuma, Halimeda, Lobophora, Symploca, Turf): ratio of in-situ to ex-situ taxon medians per Sentinel-2 band. Descriptive only.

decision_rules.D1_flat_test_index: For E4t-B: among normalised differences of B2, B3 and B4 (the 10 m bands), the index with the largest smaller-of-two AUC, in air and at 5 m after the forward model, noise and correction (primary IOPs, sigma 0.003), for kelp against bare substrate (rock and sand pooled, taxon-balanced). B1 and B5 indices are reported and not chosen. E4t-B re-checks it with its own water before registering.
decision_rules.D2_brown_against_red: The plan and README say brown algae cannot be separated from red algae. That statement is revised if, for kelp against red foliose algae or against turf, some Sentinel-2 band or normalised difference reaches AUC >= 0.8 at 1 m or deeper (primary IOPs, sigma 0.003) in both the pooled and the air-only analysis. The revision states the deepest registered depth that reaches it, the band or index, and the source. Otherwise the statement stands, with this evidence.
decision_rules.D3_library_defaults: No library default changes in this run. The CC-BY-only class medians (all sources except Rowan & Phinn) are compared with detectability.SUBSTRATE_ALBEDO (bare, brown, red) per band; a later library change cites this report, and cannot use Rowan & Phinn spectra as shipped defaults.
decision_rules.D4_detectability: z_max per Sentinel-2 band for kelp against every scored class, for each IOP set and sigma, reported beside the current Baltic-based statement (brown against bare separable to about 20 m at 444 nm).

not_delivered: E5g's predicted signal per 10 points of cover: E5g is not feasible (proposals/e5g-sesimbra-growth.md).
outputs: reports/e5s-kelp-spectra.md and reports/e5s-kelp-spectra/results.json. Only derived statistics are published; no Rowan & Phinn spectrum is copied into the repository.
